_doc: Hand-curated music & songs catalog. Iconic tracks from One Piece — in-universe songs (Bink's Sake), anime openings, OST cues, character-specific themes. Each entry: title, kind, debut chapter or episode, performers, summary.

tracks.title: Bink's Sake
tracks.summary: The most iconic in-universe song. A pirate sea shanty about a journey to deliver Bink's sake. Brook's signature performance, played at every emotional pirate moment — Whole Cake departure, Sunny christening, Thriller Bark farewell.

tracks.title: We Are!
tracks.summary: The first and most iconic anime opening. Played as the Strawhats set sail at the start of the series. Returned for major milestone episodes.

tracks.title: Hikari e
tracks.summary: Second opening — the Alabasta-era theme. The Strawhats running across the desert is iconic OP imagery from this era.

tracks.title: Hands Up!
tracks.summary: Dressrosa-era opening. Crowd-favourite chorus — fans throw their hands up at conventions.

tracks.title: Wano-Kuni
tracks.summary: Wano arc opening — bombastic samurai imagery, Kaidou storm, the rooftop fight teaser.

tracks.title: Memories
tracks.summary: First ending theme — gentle, nostalgic. Played as Luffy walks away from Foosha at the start of the journey.

tracks.title: Overtaken (Difficulty x Pride)
tracks.summary: The most iconic OST cue. Plays at impossible-victory moments — Luffy vs Lucci, Whitebeard's last stand, Marineford. Goosebumps guaranteed.

tracks.title: Mother Sea
tracks.summary: The Going Merry's farewell. Played as the crew burns the Merry — the most heart-shattering scene in the series.

tracks.title: Brook's Soul Solid Songs
tracks.summary: Brook's various Soul-King-era anthems — 'New World' (his own song), 'Dead End Adventure' covers.

tracks.title: Dawn
tracks.summary: The opening fanfare — heard before every major announcement, voyage start, treasure reveal.

tracks.title: Romance Dawn (theme)
tracks.summary: Luffy's hat / Romance Dawn motif — most associated with the Strawhat hat, Shanks's final words, and emotional callbacks.

tracks.title: Pirate King's Fanfare
tracks.summary: Plays whenever someone declares 'I'm going to be Pirate King!' Triumphant brass.

tracks.title: Difficulty x Pride
tracks.summary: Sub-cue used in Marineford and beyond — desperation-into-resolve. Often paired with Overtaken.

tracks.title: Mugiwara no Luffy Tarou (Strawhat Luffy-tarou)
tracks.summary: Wano-flavoured shamisen + brass version of the Luffy theme. Plays during his Wano sumo-style moments.

tracks.title: Drum of Liberation
tracks.summary: Gear 5 / Sun God Nika theme. Cartoon-style drums and laughter motif. Plays during Luffy's Nika awakening.

tracks.title: Binks no Sake (movie version)
tracks.summary: Stampede movie's emotional callback rendition. Used in the climactic Crew-vs-Bullet sequence.

tracks.title: Film: Red — anything by Ado
tracks.summary: Uta's set-list — 'New Genesis', 'Tot Musica', 'Backlight', 'I'm Invincible'. Ado vocals, Uta in-canon. The Red soundtrack went #1 in Japan.

tracks.title: Brand New World
tracks.summary: Post-Enies Lobby opening — Strawhat crew expanded after Robin's rescue, Sunny launched, beginning of the Thriller Bark era.
